purpose: One feasibility pilot for pixel-only recovery of missing/misread numeric citation relations; no automatic editing; not a novelty claim
source_selection: unseen documents; explicit article-level CC-BY/CC0; <=20 PDF pages; selected before any new OCR; excludes 34-page PLOS paper by cap

data_routes.europepmc: search timeouts; one query eventually returned

exclusions: AAPS article: XML only copyright statement, no explicit reusable license resolved
ACS article: AuthorChoice terms not resolved; TEI mistaken for JATS in exploratory fetch corrected using nxml, article excluded
inputs: Only raster pages plus frozen local Apple Vision outputs; PDF text, JATS, rid, gold boxes and anchors confined to evaluation
body_local_pages: first four physical pages per selected document; no gold-based region routing
whole_pages: all pages in each selected PDF, shared once across methods

local_budget.selection: first four bracket-citation positions in whole OCR then first numeric positions not nearby, then longest OCR text lines; pad blank if fewer; no gold

advanced_rule: All predicted IDs must be present in OCR-parsed bibliography and nearby whole-OCR left/right lexical anchors must agree. This is a weak candidate, not a new verifier. Keep old whole output when new candidate rejected.
comparison: B/C share identical crops and raw OCR; report common whole OCR separately; ordinary numeric mapping is not counted as innovation
negative_control: After natural inference is saved, inject a different number that also exists in OCR bibliography at the same anchor. Report separately; no synthetic deletion mixed into natural outcomes.
metrics: bibliography target text aligned to JATS
evaluation: JATS numeric bracket groups, rid->ref id, expand ranges via reference labels, align source PDF text only for scoring; manually inspect every included image anchor; exclude ambiguous/unmatched/multiline/unknown reference labels with reason
scope_limitations: Numeric bracket citations only for this initial accessible corpus, not a demonstrated superscript benchmark; first4pages excludes later body; no independent confirmation claim
continue_only_if: Data alignment valid AND naturally missing/misread citation relationships exist AND method C yields positive relation gain over B at nonincreased serious errors; numeric lookup alone insufficient
stop: One frozen run, no threshold search or iterative source expansion; failure closes this version
resources: Mac serial local Vision CPU-only request; OpenCV/BLAS2; Vision internal scheduling unbounded; no paid calls, training, GPU rental or model downloads
grobid: Not installed locally. Official native-PDF/layout-token pipeline is different input; no scores fabricated; evaluation-only PDF/JATS ceiling separately reported
